spec.title: Allowed DNS — $network / ${host:text}
spec.description: Resolved DNS queries not blocked for the selected network and host.

spec.expr:
{nodename="$network"}
|= "query resolved"
| logfmt
| __error__ = ""
| response_reason != "BLOCKED"
| question_name != ""
| question_name != "unifi."
| client_ip =~ "^${host:raw}$"
| line_format `{{ .question_name | trimSuffix "." }}  ·  client={{ .client_names | default .client_ip }}  ·  ip={{ .client_ip }}  ·  type={{ .question_type }}  ·  rcode={{ .response_code }}`

spec.title: DNS query volume and blocked percentage — $network / ${host:text}
spec.description: Total and blocked DNS queries per interval, with blocked percentage on the right axis.

spec.expr:
sum(
  count_over_time(
    {nodename="$network"}
    |= "query resolved"
    | logfmt
    | __error__ = ""
    | question_name != ""
    | client_ip =~ "^${host:raw}$"
    [$__auto]
  )
)

sum(
  count_over_time(
    {nodename="$network"}
    |= "query resolved"
    |= "response_reason=BLOCKED"
    | logfmt
    | __error__ = ""
    | response_reason = "BLOCKED"
    | question_name != ""
    | client_ip =~ "^${host:raw}$"
    [$__auto]
  )
)

100 *
sum(
  count_over_time(
    {nodename="$network"}
    |= "query resolved"
    |= "response_reason=BLOCKED"
    | logfmt
    | __error__ = ""
    | response_reason = "BLOCKED"
    | question_name != ""
    | client_ip =~ "^${host:raw}$"
    [$__auto]
  )
)
/
sum(
  count_over_time(
    {nodename="$network"}
    |= "query resolved"
    | logfmt
    | __error__ = ""
    | question_name != ""
    | client_ip =~ "^${host:raw}$"
    [$__auto]
  )
)

spec.title: Cached percentage — $network / ${host:text}
spec.description: Percentage of resolved DNS queries served from Blocky's cache.

spec.expr:
100 *
sum(
  count_over_time(
    {nodename="$network"}
    |= "query resolved"
    | logfmt
    | __error__ = ""
    | response_type = "CACHED"
    | question_name != ""
    | client_ip =~ "^${host:raw}$"
    [$__range]
  )
)
/
sum(
  count_over_time(
    {nodename="$network"}
    |= "query resolved"
    | logfmt
    | __error__ = ""
    | question_name != ""
    | client_ip =~ "^${host:raw}$"
    [$__range]
  )
)

spec.title: Queries by DNS record type
spec.description: Distribution of A, AAAA, HTTPS, PTR and other DNS question types.

spec.expr:
sum by (question_type) (
  count_over_time(
    {nodename="$network"}
    |= "query resolved"
    | logfmt
    | __error__ = ""
    | question_type != ""
    | client_ip =~ "^${host:raw}$"
    [$__range]
  )
)

spec.title: Queries by client
spec.description: Top 15 DNS clients by query volume.

spec.expr:
topk(
  15,
  sum by (client_names, client_ip) (
    count_over_time(
      {nodename="$network"}
      |= "query resolved"
      | logfmt
      | __error__ = ""
      | client_ip != ""
      | client_ip =~ "^${host:raw}$"
      [$__range]
    )
  )
)

spec.title: Blocked queries by blocklist group
spec.description: Blocky group or group combination responsible for each blocked response.

spec.expr:
sum by (block_group) (
  count_over_time(
    {nodename="$network"}
    |= "query resolved"
    |= "response_reason=BLOCKED"
    | logfmt
    | __error__ = ""
    | response_reason = "BLOCKED"
    | client_ip =~ "^${host:raw}$"
    | regexp `response_reason=BLOCKED(?: \((?P<block_group>[^)]+)\))?`
    | block_group != ""
    [$__range]
  )
)

spec.title: Response reasons
spec.description: Top-level Blocky response reason extracted from each query log entry.

spec.expr:
sum by (reason) (
  count_over_time(
    {nodename="$network"}
    |= "query resolved"
    | regexp `response_reason=(?P<reason>[A-Z_]+)`
    | reason != ""
    | logfmt
    | __error__ = ""
    | client_ip =~ "^${host:raw}$"
    [$__range]
  )
)

spec.title: Response type
spec.description: Blocky response categories such as resolved, cached and blocked.

spec.expr:
sum by (response_type) (
  count_over_time(
    {nodename="$network"}
    |= "query resolved"
    | logfmt
    | __error__ = ""
    | response_type != ""
    | client_ip =~ "^${host:raw}$"
    [$__range]
  )
)

spec.title: DNS response status
spec.description: DNS return codes such as NOERROR, NXDOMAIN and SERVFAIL.

spec.expr:
sum by (response_code) (
  count_over_time(
    {nodename="$network"}
    |= "query resolved"
    | logfmt
    | __error__ = ""
    | response_code != ""
    | client_ip =~ "^${host:raw}$"
    [$__range]
  )
)

spec.title: Average DNS response time — $network / ${host:text}
spec.description: Mean Blocky query duration for the selected time range.

spec.expr:
avg(
  avg_over_time(
    {nodename="$network"}
    |= "query resolved"
    | logfmt
    | question_name != ""
    | client_ip =~ "^${host:raw}$"
    | unwrap duration_ms
    | __error__ = ""
    [$__range]
  )
)

spec.title: Active clients — $network / ${host:text}
spec.description: Distinct client IPs that made DNS queries in the selected time range.

spec.expr:
count(
  sum by (client_ip) (
    count_over_time(
      {nodename="$network"}
      |= "query resolved"
      | logfmt
      | __error__ = ""
      | question_name != ""
      | client_ip != ""
      | client_ip =~ "^${host:raw}$"
      [$__range]
    )
  )
)

spec.title: Receive rate — $network / ${interface:text}
spec.description: Current aggregate inbound traffic rate across the selected interface scope.

spec.title: Transmit rate — $network / ${interface:text}
spec.description: Current aggregate outbound traffic rate across the selected interface scope.

spec.title: Packet rate — $network / ${interface:text}
spec.description: Combined inbound and outbound packet rate.

spec.title: Errors + drops — $network / ${interface:text}
spec.description: Combined receive/transmit errors and dropped packets per second.

spec.title: Network traffic — $network / ${interface:text}
spec.description: Inbound traffic is positive; outbound traffic is mirrored below zero for rapid comparison.

spec.title: Link utilisation — $network / ${interface:text}
spec.description: Traffic as a fraction of the interface speed reported by node_exporter; virtual and PPP links may not expose a speed.

spec.expr: (node_network_speed_bytes{instance="${node:raw}", device=~"^${interface:raw}$", device!~"lo|veth.*|docker.*"} > bool 0) * (rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{instance="${node:raw}", device=~"^${interface:raw}$", device!~"lo|veth.*|docker.*"}[$__rate_interval]) / node_network_speed_bytes{instance="${node:raw}", device=~"^${interface:raw}$", device!~"lo|veth.*|docker.*"})

(node_network_speed_bytes{instance="${node:raw}", device=~"^${interface:raw}$", device!~"lo|veth.*|docker.*"} > bool 0) * (rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{instance="${node:raw}", device=~"^${interface:raw}$", device!~"lo|veth.*|docker.*"}[$__rate_interval]) / node_network_speed_bytes{instance="${node:raw}", device=~"^${interface:raw}$", device!~"lo|veth.*|docker.*"})

spec.title: Packets per second — $network / ${interface:text}
spec.description: Inbound and outbound packet rates per interface.

spec.title: Interface errors and drops — $network / ${interface:text}
spec.description: Receive/transmit errors and drops per second, separated by interface.

spec.title: Blocked DNS — $network / ${host:text}
spec.description: Blocked DNS queries with the matched block group for the selected network and host.

spec.expr:
{nodename="$network"}
|= "query resolved"
|= "response_reason=BLOCKED"
!= "stats.grafana.org"
| logfmt
| __error__ = ""
| response_reason = "BLOCKED"
| question_name != ""
| client_ip =~ "^${host:raw}$"
| regexp `response_reason=BLOCKED(?: \((?P<block_group>[^)]+)\))?`
| line_format `{{ .question_name | trimSuffix "." }}  ·  client={{ .client_names | default .client_ip }}  ·  ip={{ .client_ip }}  ·  type={{ .question_type }}  ·  group={{ .block_group | default "-" }}`

spec.title: IP firewall blocks — $network / ${host:text}
spec.description: Firewall block events sourced by the selected client IP.

spec.expr:
{nodename="$network"} |~ `nft-block-(feed|local|doh|port) `
| regexp `(?P<kind>nft-block-[a-z]+) .*SRC=(?P<src>[^ ]+) DST=(?P<dst>[^ ]+)`
| src =~ "^${host:raw}$"
| dst != ""
| regexp `PROTO=(?P<proto>[A-Z]+)`
| regexp `DPT=(?P<dport>[0-9]+)`
| line_format `{{ .kind }}  ·  {{ .src }} → {{ .dst }}{{ if .dport }}:{{ .dport }}{{ end }}  ·  {{ .proto }}`

spec.title: IP block types — $network / ${host:text}
spec.description: Stacked firewall block counts by nftables block category.

spec.title: Top 20 blocked domains — $network / ${host:text}
spec.description: Most frequently blocked DNS names in the selected time range.

spec.expr:
topk(
  20,
  sum by (question_name) (
    count_over_time(
      {nodename="$network"}
      |= "response_reason=BLOCKED"
      != "stats.grafana.org"
      | logfmt
      | __error__ = ""
      | response_reason = "BLOCKED"
      | question_name != ""
      | client_ip =~ "^${host:raw}$"
      [$__range]
    )
  )
)

spec.title: CAKE tins — $network
spec.description: One row per shaper tin. Throughput is what the tin is carrying; threshold is the rate above which CAKE stops giving it priority and falls back to serving it by weight. Voice sitting well under its threshold is the condition prioritisation depends on.

spec.title: Tin throughput — $network
spec.description: Traffic carried by each CAKE tin. Calls marked by the qos-mark chain appear in Voice; everything unclassified sits in Best Effort.

spec.title: Tin average delay — $network
spec.description: Sojourn time inside each tin, straight from CAKE. This is the panel that answers whether prioritisation is working: Voice should stay flat and low while Best Effort climbs under load.

spec.title: Penalty classes — $network
spec.description: The HTB classes that the throttle and imo lists steer into. These bypass CAKE entirely, so they never appear in the tin panels above.

spec.title: Classification rules — $network
spec.description: Match rate of each rule in the nftables qos-mark chain. A rule sitting at zero when it should not be is the fastest way to spot classification that has silently stopped matching — the STUN signature especially.

spec.name: network
spec.label: Network
spec.description: Router/network to inspect.

spec.name: ds_prometheus
spec.label: Prometheus
spec.description: Prometheus data source containing node_exporter metrics.

spec.name: node
spec.label: Node instance
spec.description: Prometheus node_exporter instance mapped from the selected network's nodename.

spec.name: interface
spec.label: Interface
spec.description: Network interface on the selected router; loopback and container veth interfaces are excluded.

spec.name: host
spec.label: Host IP
spec.description: Client IPs observed on the selected network. Requires client_ip to be a Loki label.
